name: AT-076
summary: AT-076 is a so-called opioid "pan" antagonist and is the first reasonably balanced antagonist known of all four opioid receptor types.75 nM). AT-076 was derived from the κ-opioid receptor antagonist JDTic, which showed affinity for NOP, by removal of two methyl groups from the piperidine ring. This increased affinity for NOP 10-fold relative to the parent compound.

pharmacology.text: AT-076 is a so-called opioid "pan" antagonist and is the first reasonably balanced antagonist known of all four opioid receptor types. AT-076 was derived from the κ-opioid receptor antagonist JDTic, which showed affinity for NOP, by removal of two methyl groups from the piperidine ring.

uses.en: It is a laboratory research tool used to study the opioid receptors. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究鴉片受體的實驗室工具，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究鸦片受体的实验室工具，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is the first compound known to block all four opioid receptor types roughly equally, which makes it a useful tool for separating out what each receptor does.
fact.zh: 它是已知第一個能大致均等地阻斷全部四種鴉片受體的化合物，因此成為區分各受體功能的有用工具。
fact.zhHans: 它是已知第一个能大致均等地阻断全部四种鸦片受体的化合物，因此成为区分各受体功能的有用工具。
